doctor.failed: Fix the items marked ✗ and run `meli-orders doctor` again.
store.authorizing: A browser window will open for you to approve the store's access. It is the store's isolated browser, not your usual one.
login.open: Log in to Mercado Libre in the window that opened. Waiting up to 15 minutes.
error.busy: Another run is using this store's browser. Wait for it to finish.
result.unconfirmed: PAYMENT NOT CONFIRMED, check «Mis compras» before running again
result.dry_run: reached the payment screen, nothing paid
approval.how: To approve: meli-orders run <store> --approve '{order}'  (exit code {code} means an approval is pending)
approval.ask_mode: From now on, for {product}: [1] buy automatically  [2] ask me before every purchase
note.purchased: Mercado Libre {day}: bought, purchase #{purchase}, total {total} {currency}, account {account}
note.manual: Mercado Libre {day}: NOT bought, needs manual review. {reason}
reason.address_without_number: The shipping address has no street number.
reason.invalid_phone: The phone number is not valid: {phone}
reason.incomplete_address: The shipping address has no name or no city.
reason.address_not_found: Mercado Libre does not recognise «{street}» in {city}.
reason.map_shows_other_address: Mercado Libre's map shows a different address from the order's.
reason.review_shows_other_address: The payment screen does not show the customer's address.
reason.mixed_products: The order mixes products, or has one that is not configured.
reason.unknown_variant: The order has a variant that is not in the product's configuration.
reason.unconfirmed_payment: A payment was started and its confirmation was never seen. Check «Mis compras» in Mercado Libre, then fix the order's tags by hand.
reason.waiting_manual_review: Flagged for manual review earlier. Remove the tag mercadolibre-manual, or run with --retry-manual.
reason.not_buyable: The listing cannot be bought right now (no «Comprar ahora»).
reason.seller_changed: The listing no longer shows the seller {seller}.
reason.quantity_unavailable: The listing does not offer {units} units.
reason.quantity_not_confirmed: The payment screen does not confirm {units} units.
reason.checkout_not_reached: The listing did not lead to the payment screen.
reason.session_expired: The Mercado Libre session expired. Run `meli-orders store login <store>`.
reason.review_unreadable: The total on the payment screen could not be read.
reason.over_cap: The total {total} is over the cap {cap} for this order.
reason.daily_cap: The daily cap {cap} would be exceeded (spent today: {spent}).
reason.balance_unreadable: The Mercado Pago balance could not be read.
reason.insufficient_balance: The Mercado Pago balance ({balance}) does not cover what is pending ({needed}). Add funds and run again.
reason.unexpected_screen: Mercado Libre showed an unexpected screen: {detail}
reason.shopify_sync_failed: Bought, but Shopify could not be updated: {detail}
reason.wrong_account: The browser is logged in as {found}; this store expects {expected}. Run `meli-orders store login <store>`.
reason.login_not_seen: No Mercado Libre login was seen.
reason.first_purchase_not_approved: The first purchase of this product has to be approved before choosing a mode.
reason.store_domain_not_found: No Shopify store was found at {address}. Use its internal domain instead: in the Shopify admin, Settings → Domains, the entry ending in .myshopify.com. The same code is in the admin's address: admin.shopify.com/store/<code>.
fix.uv: Install uv: brew install uv  (or https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
fix.shopify: Install the Shopify CLI: brew tap shopify/shopify && brew install shopify-cli
fix.platform: Only macOS has been run. Connecting a store opens the browser through macOS's `open`.
fix.local_ignored: The folder local/ must be ignored by git: restore the line /local/ in .gitignore.
fix.language: Choose the language: meli-orders settings es  (or en)
fix.config: Correct the file named above; `meli-orders validate` checks it.
fix.site_unvalidated: This Mercado Libre site has never been run end to end; only Chile (MLC) has.
fix.shopify_auth: Authorize the store: meli-orders store add {store} <the store's web address>
fix.meli_login: Log in to Mercado Libre: meli-orders store login {store}
fix.no_products: Configure a product: meli-orders product init {store} ...
fix.no_store: Connect a store: meli-orders store add <store> <the store's web address>
